text:
Ana (Partnerships): quick sync — launching Sparkline Systems HW EAP. NDA signed last night (thanks Dana). Need clarity on: 1) benchmark matrix we run, 2) telemetry / data sharing limits, 3) marketplace packaging + naming and press timing.

Mike (Infra Eng): I pushed a perf harness to s3://redwood-eap/sparkline/harness-v2.tar.gz. Small kv-cache tweak required for longer sequences. Planning a baseline run tomorrow AM.

Jordan (Sparkline): thanks team — we validated firmware v1.2.1 on 4/2; we can push a minor scheduler update Friday if needed. No customer data will be shared outside the agreed telemetry fields.

Dana (Legal): noted — NDA still needs one redline: minimum telemetry aggregation window (we want 24h rolling, they requested 1h). Can we avoid per-UUID traces? please confirm.

Kevin (Eng-ML): propose the benchmark matrix: batch sizes [1,8,32], seq lengths [128,512,1024], models: gpt-medium-3b, gpt-12b-open, quantized variants. Measure: p50/p95 latency, sustained throughput (tokens/sec), mem footprint. Also run quality sanity (100-sample prompts) to ensure quantization no-regress.

Olga (Product): marketplace draft attached in drive: https://drive.redwood/sparkline-marketplace-draft. Question — do we want the badge "Sparkline-Optimized" or just "Sparkline-Validated"? Marketing prefers the first but legal might push back.

Mike (Infra Eng): timeline/owners: baseline runs by Thu EOD (me), firmware update test Fri (Jordan), telemetry schema finalize by Wed (Dana + Kevin), marketplace copy freeze next Tue (Olga). I'll create a run ticket in JIRA.

Kevin (Eng-ML): small hint: use continuous KV cache warmup before measuring steady throughput — I have a script snippet below that we used internally.

```bash
# warmup + steady run
python perf_runner.py --model gpt-medium-3b --seq 512 --batch 8 --warmup 200 --iters 2000 > run-logs.txt
```

Jordan (Sparkline): that script looks good. We'll also capture per-GPU util and temperature — sending telemetry export format by EOD.

Dana (Legal): agreed to tensor-level telemetry as long as it is aggregated and not tied to customer request IDs. I'll post suggested language here by 6pm.

deploy-bot: Test perf run started: run-4567 (owner: Mike). Logs: https://ci.redwood/runs/run-4567

Ana (Partnerships): action items recap: Mike run baseline (Thu), Jordan firmware window (Fri), Dana provide telemetry language (Wed 6pm), Kevin supply eval prompts and quality checks (Tue), Olga finalize marketplace copy (next Tue). We'll aim for a joint announcement ~2 weeks after baseline if no blockers. Please react with :thumbsup: when you confirm ownership.

Mike (Infra Eng): :thumbsup: I got the run.

Jordan (Sparkline): :thumbsup: will schedule firmware window.

Dana (Legal): I will post redline PR tonight.

Kevin (Eng-ML): will drop 100 prompts into the drive folder by EOD.

Olga (Product): copying PM and marketing — will update the draft.

Ana (Partnerships): great — keeping thread here for audit. If anything changes, ping me directly.
